paragraphs.zh: gegebenenfalls durch ein oder mehrere, gleiche oder verschiedene Reste aus der Gruppe Halogen, Alkylthio und Alkyloxy substituiert sind, oder
paragraphs.en: optionally substituted by one or more identical or different radicals from the group consisting of halogen, alkylthio and alkyloxy, or
paragraphs.notes: Tail of the R7 definition begun on the preceding page (printed page 79), which ends there with "wobei die acht letztgenannten Gruppen". The zh field holds the verbatim German, since this is a German-language WO publication and not Chinese. Printed as "Alkyloxy" here, not "Alkoxy" as in the neighbouring definitions; transcribed as printed.

paragraphs.zh: zwei an einem gemeinsamen Kohlenstoffatom gebundene Reste R7 bilden eine Kette aus der Gruppe  OCH2CH2O, OCH2CH2CH2O, SCH2CH2S und SCH2CH2CH2S, wobei diese gegebenenfalls durch ein bis vier Methylgruppen substituiert ist, oder
paragraphs.en: two radicals R7 bonded to a common carbon atom form a chain from the group consisting of  OCH2CH2O, OCH2CH2CH2O, SCH2CH2S and SCH2CH2CH2S, this chain being optionally substituted by one to four methyl groups, or
paragraphs.notes: Alternative within the R7 definition; no label of its own is printed. Superscript 7 on R is printed as a superscript; the 2 in every CH2 of the four chains is printed as a subscript. Two spaces are printed after "Gruppe" before OCH2CH2O and are kept. "substituiert ist" is singular in the printed German although "diese" follows a list of four chains; transcribed as printed and translated literally. A small stray ink mark sits just above the superscript 7 of R7 on the first line; it is scan speckle, not a printed character.

paragraphs.zh: zwei an direkt benachbarten Kohlenstoffatomen gebundene Reste R7 bilden eine Bindung oder bilden mit dem sie tragenden Kohlenstoffatomen einen gegebenenfalls durch ein oder mehrere, gleiche oder verschiedene Reste aus der Gruppe Halogen, Alkyl,  Alkylthio und Alkoxy substituierten 3- bis 6-gliedrigen Ring;
paragraphs.en: two radicals R7 bonded to directly adjacent carbon atoms form a bond or form, together with the carbon atoms carrying them, a 3- to 6-membered ring optionally substituted by one or more identical or different radicals from the group consisting of halogen, alkyl,  alkylthio and alkoxy;
paragraphs.notes: Final alternative of the R7 definition. Superscript 7 on R. "mit dem sie tragenden Kohlenstoffatomen" mixes singular "dem" with plural "Kohlenstoffatomen" as printed; transcribed as printed. Two spaces are printed after "Alkyl," and are kept.

paragraphs.zh: R12    Wasserstoff, Alkyl, Halogenalkyl, Alkoxyalkyl, Formyl, Alkylcarbonyl, Alkoxycarbonyl, Alkylaminocarbonyl, Dialkylaminocarbonyl, Alkylsulfonyl, Halogenalkylsulfonyl, Benzoyl oder Phenylsulfonyl, wobei die beiden letztgenannten Gruppen gegebenenfalls durch ein oder mehrere, gleiche oder verschiedene Reste aus der Gruppe Alkyl, Halogenalkyl, Alkoxy, Halogenalkoxy, Halogen, Cyano und Nitro substituiert sind;
paragraphs.en: R12    hydrogen, alkyl, haloalkyl, alkoxyalkyl, formyl, alkylcarbonyl, alkoxycarbonyl, alkylaminocarbonyl, dialkylaminocarbonyl, alkylsulfonyl, haloalkylsulfonyl, benzoyl or phenylsulfonyl, the two last-mentioned groups being optionally substituted by one or more identical or different radicals from the group consisting of alkyl, haloalkyl, alkoxy, haloalkoxy, halogen, cyano and nitro;
paragraphs.notes: Superscript 12 on R. This is the R12 referred to by OR12 in the R6 definition on the preceding page.

paragraphs.zh: L    eine gegebenenfalls durch ein oder mehrere, gleiche oder verschiedene Reste R2 substituierte C1-C6-Alkylenkette;
paragraphs.en: L    a C1-C6 alkylene chain optionally substituted by one or more identical or different radicals R2;
paragraphs.notes: Superscript 2 on R; the 1 and 6 in C1-C6 are printed as subscripts.

paragraphs.zh: Y    eine divalente Einheit aus der Gruppe O, S, N-H, N-Alkyl, CHR7 oder C(R7)2;
paragraphs.en: Y    a divalent unit from the group consisting of O, S, N-H, N-alkyl, CHR7 or C(R7)2;
paragraphs.notes: Superscript 7 on both occurrences of R; the 2 in C(R7)2 is printed as a subscript, and the closing semicolon is set on the subscript baseline.

paragraphs.zh: Z    eine direkte Bindung, eine divalente Einheit aus der Gruppe O, S, SO, SO2, N-H, N-Alkyl, CHR7 oder C(R7)2;
paragraphs.en: Z    a direct bond, a divalent unit from the group consisting of O, S, SO, SO2, N-H, N-alkyl, CHR7 or C(R7)2;
paragraphs.notes: Superscript 7 on both occurrences of R; the 2 in SO2 and in C(R7)2 is printed as a subscript, and the comma after SO2 and the closing semicolon after C(R7)2 sit on the subscript baseline. A small stray ink dot sits between the Z and the indented text; it is scan speckle, not a printed character.
Lower-case v, the exponent on the ring-expansion bracket in formula (I) on the preceding page.

Printed with no space after the first comma, as "0,1, 2, 3 oder 4,"; transcribed as printed. The entry ends with a comma, not a semicolon or full stop, so the definition list continues on the following page.
